info.name: Business Insights API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Business Insights App backend.

How to use:
1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. (Optional) Change the `base_url` collection variable — it defaults to the live Render deployment. For local development set it to http://localhost:5000.
3. Run the **Login** request once. Its Tests script automatically stores the JWT into the `token` collection variable.
4. Run any of the protected requests (Get Business, Get Insights, Get Reviews) — they inherit the collection-level Bearer auth using `{{token}}`.

Every response (success and error) uses the same envelope: `{ "success": boolean, "message": string, "data": object | array | null }`.

Demo credentials: admin@abcsalon.com / Password123

request.description: Public health-check endpoint. No authentication required. Returns the standard envelope with the server uptime (in seconds) in `data.uptime`. Note: on the Render free tier the very first request after idle can take ~50 seconds while the instance cold-starts.

Public login endpoint. Send the demo credentials (admin@abcsalon.com / Password123) as raw JSON. On success (200) the response contains a JWT in `data.token` — the Tests script on this request automatically saves it into the `token` collection variable, so all protected requests work immediately afterwards.

Error cases:
- 400 when email or password is missing/empty (`"Email and password are required"`).
- 401 when credentials are wrong (`"Invalid email or password"`).

response.name: 400 Bad Request - Missing fields

request.description:
Protected endpoint — requires a Bearer JWT (inherited from collection auth via `{{token}}`; run **Login** first). Returns the business profile: id, name, category, address, phone, rating, total_reviews.

Without a valid token it returns 401 with the standard error envelope.

response.name: 200 OK - Business profile
401 Unauthorized - Missing or invalid token

request.description:
Protected endpoint — requires a Bearer JWT (inherited from collection auth via `{{token}}`; run **Login** first). Returns the business insight metrics: id, profile_views, search_views, website_clicks, phone_calls, direction_requests. These power the dashboard chart in the mobile app.

Without a valid token it returns 401 with the standard error envelope.

Protected endpoint — requires a Bearer JWT (inherited from collection auth via `{{token}}`; run **Login** first). Returns an array of customer reviews (id, name, rating, comment, date) sorted by date DESCENDING (newest first).

Without a valid token it returns 401 with the standard error envelope.

response.name: 200 OK - Reviews (newest first)
